domain: Stripe live-mode webhooks demo. A checkout/billing service whose source of truth is its own database; Stripe is the payment processor. When PaymentIntents transition (confirm, cancel) the mock fires the same webhooks Stripe would, so the service's sync layer can be exercised end-to-end without touching real Stripe.

personas.name: webhook-demo
personas.description: A small checkout service with a handful of customers and PaymentIntents. Used to demonstrate that confirming or canceling a PaymentIntent against the mock fires real outbound webhooks (payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.canceled) to the service's endpoint.
